complete_examples.text: It finds that foundation defects have a significant impact on the train’s operational state, track vibration displacement, and vibration stress of the tunnel lining structure, especially under the coupling effect of basement voids and the water-rich environment, which has the greatest impact.

Wang et al. [14] used numerical methods to study the dynamic response characteristics of the tunnel bottom structure in water-rich strata under the action of heavy haul trains and pointed out that the influence depth of heavy haul trains on the surrounding rock of water-rich tunnels is about 5 m. Yang et al. [15], based on the impact of voids on the mechanical behavior of tunnel structures, used the 2D particle discrete element method to elucidate the formation and evolution of voids induced by heavy haul train loads, studying the dynamic response of the basement surrounding rock under underwater, drying, and water-saturated conditions, which revealed the formation process of basement voids from a microscopic perspective.
